Founder: When did a client last pay you late?
Tomas: Last month. A retail client was sixty days late on a 4,000 euro invoice.
Founder: What did you do about it that week?
Tomas: I spent about three hours writing emails and in the end I phoned their finance person twice. We used a spreadsheet to track who owes what, and my partner checks it every Friday.
Founder: What did that cost you, besides the hours?
Tomas: We paid a freelancer late because of it. Last year we also paid a collections agency 400 euros on one invoice.
Founder: Is there anyone else at the studio who deals with this?
Tomas: My partner Ana does the books. I can introduce you to her, she has a much longer list of horror stories.
Founder: That would help. Could we also look at the spreadsheet together?
Tomas: Sure. Let's book a call next Tuesday at 10 and I will share my screen.
